title: Vietnamese Semolina Cake
description: A traditional Vietnamese dessert with semolina, coconut milk, and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together semolina, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together coconut milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour in the vanilla extract, if using.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with toasted coconut flakes or powdered sugar, if desired.
